channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Poundland in Rescue Talks as Poundstretcher Owner Withdraws Bid
item.description: Poundland is currently in rescue talks as its owners are seeking a buyer. The owner of rival retailer Poundstretcher had previously considered a rescue bid but has now withdrawn it. The leadership team at Poundland is attempting a buyout… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: IMF revises global economic outlook upwards

item.title: Global Bond Yields Decline Amid Inflation Data Anticipation
item.description: Global bond yields, including those for U.S. Treasuries and in the Eurozone, have decreased as markets await the release of U.S. inflation data. The decline in yields is partly attributed to a pullback in energy prices. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Factory Workers Blame Trump Tariffs for Job Losses
item.description: Factory workers in the United States have attributed job losses to tariffs imposed by the Trump administration. A study found that these tariffs increased the prices of everyday goods. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Social Security COLA for 2027 Expected to Break Norms
item.description: The Social Security Cost-of-Living Adjustment (COLA) for 2027 is set to be announced on Wednesday. Projections suggest this COLA could deviate from historical norms, although challenges remain. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Japan-controlled tankers return to Middle East after conflict
item.description: Japan-controlled oil tankers have resumed voyages to the Middle East after a seven-month absence due to conflict in the Persian Gulf. Refiners and shipowners had previously avoided the region. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Global Smartphone Shipments Hit 14-Year Low in Q3
item.description: Global smartphone shipments experienced their worst third quarter in 14 years, a decline attributed in part to a memory shortage. In China, smartphone shipments have fallen for six consecutive quarters. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The 23rd China-ASEAN Expo has concluded, focusing on new cooperation opportunities within the Free Trade Area 3.0. The event aimed to share these opportunities. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: India's September retail inflation at 5.54%, food inflation at 7.74%
item.description: India's retail inflation rate was 5.54% in September, according to data released. Food inflation specifically rose to 7.74% during the same month. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.
